data.summary: All figures match what I recall of NVIDIA's reported FY2025 and FY2024 results (unverified against the filing): revenue $130.5B vs $60.9B (+114.2%), net income $72.9B vs $29.8B (+144.9%), operating cash flow $64.1B vs $28.1B, total assets $111.6B vs $65.7B, total liabilities $32.3B vs $22.8B, cash $8.6B vs $7.3B. The conclusions are reasonable. The cash figure leaves out marketable securities (about $43B in total cash and investments), which is context rather than an error.
